title: Fang Prime
extract:
The Fang Prime is the primed version of the dual  Fang daggers, acting as a direct upgrade.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Gnashing Payara and  Biting Piranha (Conclave only) stance.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Grants a 5% Movement Speed bonus when held (i.e. melee mode or quick melee).

High crit chance (26.00%)
High follow through (0.8x)

Acquisition

On October 16th, 2018, a built Fang Prime,  Vectis Prime and an exclusive Sugatra were available as Twitch Prime benefits.

Crafting

Trivia
The Fang Prime, alongside  Afuris Prime,  Akbolto Prime,  Aksomati Prime,  Akstiletto Prime,  Ballistica Prime,  Cernos Prime,  Dual Kamas Prime,  Dual Keres Prime,  Gunsen Prime,  Paris Prime and  Zhuge Prime are the only Prime weapons that do not require Orokin Cells as crafting ingredients.
